companyFieldUpdates.name: Live Oak Wind Farm
companyFieldUpdates.description: Live Oak Wind Farm is an operating approximately 200 MW onshore wind project in Schleicher County, Texas, held through Live Oak Wind Project, LLC and Live Oak Wind Partners, LLC. The project uses 76 Siemens Gamesa turbines and sells renewable generation into ERCOT; ENGIE remains operator. John Laing acquired a 75% sponsor interest in 2019 while ENGIE retained 25%. That 75% block later entered John Laing Investments Limited, which direct April 2026 evidence describes as 50:50 owned by Equitix and KKR-owned John Laing Group. The Equitix and KKR percentages apply to JLIL and are not recorded as inferred direct 37.5% project stakes. John Laing is preserved as the former 2019 acquirer and current KKR-owned asset manager rather than a third independent current owner. Lenders, tax-equity investors, hedging counterparties, offtakers and project subsidiaries are not separate PortCos. No later project sale or signed pending ownership transaction was identified through August 29, 2026.
